exposure: elective repeat cesarean deliveries at 37-39 weeks' gestation
cohort: 856 singleton pregnancies scheduled for elective repeat cesarean deliveries at 37-39 weeks' gestation
finding: Performing elective repeat cesarean deliveries from the second half of the 37th week of gestation until the 38th week of gestation may be optimal for reducing neonatal respiratory disorders and emergent cesarean deliveries in the Asian population.
mod_finding: Elective repeat cesarean deliveries from the second half of the 37th week of gestation until the 38th week of gestation may be optimal for reducing neonatal respiratory disorders and emergent cesarean deliveries in the Asian population.
